Why are we updating the Water Supply Strategy?
The water supply strategy is a ‘roadmap’ for the long-term provision of safe, secure and sustainable water supply for
the Region.
Updates to the water supply strategy are necessary to ensure alignment with:
• Existing and future growth needs                       • Sustainability practices
• Current regulatory framework                           • Technology advancements
• Environmental changes

Where do we get our drinking water?




                                Region of Waterloo - Water Supply Strategy Update

The integrated urban system
This project will focus on supply needs
within the Region’s Integrated Urban
System (shown in dark blue) and includes
Kitchener,Waterloo, Cambridge, and some
communities in the surrounding townships.

Integrated urban system existing drinking water
wells

Existing efficiency and
conservation initiatives
Existing water efficiency and conservation programs
include:
• Water Conservation By-law
• W.E.T. Home Water Review
• Funding for multi-residential buildings to replace
  fixtures
• Funding for business Water Efficient Certification
  Program
• Community, school, and youth education
• Water softener education and incentives
Water is a limited resource that we all
share.Together, we need to use it wisely.
